tools.name: lang_detect
tools.description: Identify the language of a short piece of text with a reliability verdict and ranked alternatives.

tools.name: model_tools
tools.description: Inspect and control the on-device models available to this agent: list what each one does and whether it can run on this machine, install a model's tool, or remove one. Installs and removals are remembered across restarts. Use it before calling a model tool when unsure which one fits, to install a model the user asked for, or to explain why a model is unavailable here. Models that cannot run in this process report the exact reason.

tools.name: tool_mode_describe
tools.description: Describe one or more tools by name: the selected input/output schemas, the resolved model, limits and the catalog revision. Read-only discovery (DECL-07): it never installs, prepares, activates or changes anything.

tools.name: tool_mode_list
tools.description: List the tools this caller is permitted to use, with readiness summaries and the current catalog revision. Read-only discovery (DECL-07): it never installs, prepares, activates or changes anything.

tools.name: tool_mode_run
tools.description: Run a program that calls Tool Mode tools (CODE-02). The requested `tools` list is a binding subset, not a grant: only names the host itself has granted are bound, and the whole request is refused when any name is unattainable.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.
